grammarFocus: 第三人称单数；do / does 问答；like；can / cannot；and / but。
title: A Family Dinner Conversation
instructions: 本材料为项目原创模拟教学材料，情境和数据均为模拟，非官方试题，未经真实考生难度标定。先读题，再听录音；建议第一遍抓大意，第二遍核对细节。共 8 题；单选题只选一个完整选项。填空用录音中的英文原词或数字，遵守每题词数限制。
transcript:
Tom: Hi, Lily. Does your brother like fish?
Lily: No, he doesn't. He likes chicken. But he can't cook.
Tom: Can you cook chicken?
Lily: Yes, I can. I cook it with rice. My sister likes salad. She doesn't like fish.
Tom: Does your father like salad?
Lily: No, he doesn't. He likes noodles. He can cook noodles.
Tom: What about your mother?
Lily: She likes soup. She can make good soup. But she doesn't like salad.
Tom: So, who likes salad?
Lily: My sister and I. We like salad. And we can make it.

questions.prompt: Lily 的兄弟喜欢什么食物？
questions.explanation: 录音中Lily说“He likes chicken.”，所以哥哥喜欢鸡肉。
录音中Lily说“But he can't cook.”，所以哥哥不会做饭。
录音中Lily说“Yes, I can.”，所以她会做饭。

questions.explanation: Lily 明确说做鸡肉搭配 rice（米饭）。这与姐妹喜欢沙拉是不同的事实。

grammar.title: 第三人称单数；do/does 问答；like；can/cannot；and/but
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时中，第三人称单数主语（如 he、she、it）搭配普通动词的 -s/-es 形式。用 does 提问、does not/doesn't 否定时，后面普通动词恢复原形。can 表示能力，所有主语后都用 can + 动词原形；否定用 cannot 或 can't。and 表示并列，but 表示转折，要结合想表达的意思选择。
grammar.example: He likes chicken. But he can't cook.

questions.explanation: She 是第三人称单数，一般现在时的 like 变成 likes。

questions.explanation: 用 does 提问后，like 使用原形。

questions.explanation: can 的否定形式是 can't，后接动词原形 swim。

questions.prompt: 选择表达“但是”的词：I like fruit, ______ I don't like oranges.
questions.explanation: 题目要求表达转折“但是”，所以用 but。
questions.evidence: I like fruit, but I don't like oranges.
